messages:
Maya: Hey team! Quick idea: 'Aurora Postcard Dash' — send a postcard to someone in a different region. We'll also have a tiny plant-adoption table + sticker packs at HQ next Friday. Sign up below with your timezone. :postcard: :evergreen_tree:
Sam: Love it. Count me in. Can we add a 'random pairing' option? :sparkles:
Jorge: I'll donate three vintage postcard designs. How do folks want to share mailing addresses? Probably not in-channel. Google sheet?
Olivia: I'll spin up a sheet in a sec. Columns: `Slack handle`, `Name for label`, `City/Region`, `Remote or Office`, `Prefer plant/sticker/none`. Link: http://tiny.redwood/aurora-postcards (placeholder)
Cal: Remote (APAC) — happy to receive and to send locally. Also can help with SF mailroom drop-offs if anyone in the Bay needs it.
Maya: Nice — plan is: drop physical postcards in the 'Postcard Box' at reception starting Thu. Please label like `PC-<slack>` on the envelope so we can route. International postage is on sender. :world_map:
SleighBot: Reminder scheduled: "Postcard Box goes live" Thu 9:00 AM local. :bell:
Sam: Also mini poll: which plant should we default for the adoption table? React with :one: :two: or :three: — 1) Pothos 2) Snake plant 3) Spider plant :seedling:
Olivia: Added reactions to the thread. :one: from me (pothos).
Jorge: Small idea — include a one-line 'fun fact' on the postcard: `Hi from [city]! Fun fact: ...` I can make a tiny template if folks want.
Cal: If there are many EU shippers I can coordinate a bulk stamp run with our campus post office and save on confusion.
Maya: Love the plan — sign-ups close Wed EOD so we can print a little map for the table. Sheet again: http://tiny.redwood/aurora-postcards. Thanks folks! :raised_hands:
